# Utah Civic Compact

> Utah Civic Compact is a nonpartisan 501(c)(4) civic organization based in Utah and an established voice in the state's civic dialogue. We defend the agreement between Utah communities and their government — ensuring residents have genuine voice and consent in the decisions that shape their lives, holding institutions accountable when they break that agreement, and building lasting civic capacity statewide.

## Who We Are

Utah Civic Compact was founded in 2024. We operate statewide across all 29 Utah counties. We are nonpartisan — we work with anyone willing to honor the compact between communities and government, regardless of party affiliation.

## Active Investigations

- **License Plate Reader Investigation (Weber County)** — Records obtained by Utah Civic Compact show ten Flock Safety automated license plate reader cameras in Weber County were searched 5.1 million times by law enforcement in 45 states, with almost 97% of searches coming from agencies outside Utah. 41.4% of searches carry a stated reason that matches no purpose Utah law permits. Covered by Utah News Dispatch and KSL.
- **Weber County Election Law Complaint** — Did three county commission candidates violate Utah campaign finance law by hiding legal fees for a bad-faith ballot disqualification lawsuit against an opponent? Filed June 4, 2026.
- **Stratos Project (Box Elder County)** — Challenging MIDA's approval of a 9-gigawatt natural gas–powered data center in Hansel Valley, approved without adequate community input. Covered by FOX 13, KSL, and KUTV.

## What We Work On

- **Surveillance & Privacy** — Automated license plate readers, data sharing between agencies, and the erosion of private space.
- **Redistricting & Fair Maps** — Fighting gerrymandering and ensuring electoral districts reflect the communities within them.
- **Ballot Access & Voting Rights** — Defending every eligible Utahn's right to vote without barriers.
- **Government Transparency** — Advocating for open records, public meetings, and accountability in government decision-making.
- **Local & Community Governance** — Strengthening democratic accountability at the city, county, and school board level.
- **Ethics & Anti-Corruption** — Pushing for strong ethics rules and real enforcement against conflicts of interest.
- **Civic Education & Engagement** — Building civic infrastructure so Utah residents know their rights and have the tools to use them.
- **Data Center Development & Community Consent** — Opposing large-scale industrial data center projects imposed on communities without genuine public input or consent.
